title: Number of Adjacent Elements With the Same Color
accessAttempt: WebFetch on the official page returns 403; constraints and examples taken from WebSearch result text citing leetcode.com.
summary: An array of n uncolored (0) positions receives colorings from queries [index, color]. After each query, return the number of adjacent pairs with the same nonzero color.
officialConstraints: 1 <= n <= 10^5; 1 <= queries.length <= 10^5; queries[i].length == 2; 0 <= index_i <= n - 1; 1 <= color_i <= 10^5
visualizationNotes: Visualization cap: n <= 50 and queries.length <= 50; colors remain up to 10^5.
